def: a track or passage-way (as if flowing along)

occurrences.text: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
Because my people hath forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths, to walk in paths, in a way not cast up;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
